name: 雷霆万钧
bonus4pc: 当装备者施放终结技时，速度提高20%，持续1回合
bonus4pcEn: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases SPD by 20% for 1 turn.

name: 街头拳击手
bonus4pc: 当装备者发起攻击后，攻击力提高5%，该效果最多叠加5层
bonus4pcEn: After the wearer attacks, ATK increases by 5% for the rest of the battle. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

name: 流星追迹的怪盗
bonus4pc: 当装备者造成弱点击破后，额外提高16%击破特攻，并恢复3点能量
bonus4pcEn: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by 16%. After the wearer inflicts Weakness Break, regenerates 3 Energy.

name: 天才们的超距通讯
bonus4pc: 当装备者对敌方目标造成伤害时，无视其10%防御力。若目标拥有量子弱点，则额外无视10%防御力
bonus4pcEn: When the wearer deals DMG to an enemy, ignores 10% DEF. If the enemy has Quantum Weakness, additionally ignores 10% DEF.

name: 熔岩锻铸的火匠
bonus4pc: 战技造成的伤害提高12%。施放终结技后，火属性伤害提高12%，持续1次攻击
bonus4pcEn: Increases Skill DMG by 12%. After using Ultimate, Fire DMG increases by 12% for 1 attack.

name: 寒霜猎手的极光
bonus4pc: 当装备者施放终结技时，暴击伤害提高25%，持续2回合
bonus4pcEn: After using Ultimate, increases CRIT DMG by 25% for 2 turns.

name: 净庭教宗的圣骑士
bonus4pc: 当装备者为队友提供护盾时，护盾持有者造成的伤害提高10%
bonus4pcEn: When the wearer provides a Shield to an ally, increases the Shield holder's DMG by 10%.

name: 宝命长存的莳者
bonus4pc: 当装备者受到攻击时，暴击率提高8%，持续2回合，该效果最多叠加2层
bonus4pcEn: When the wearer is hit, CRIT Rate increases by 8% for 2 turns. This effect can stack up to 2 times.

name: 骇域漫游的信使
bonus4pc: 当装备者对队友施放战技或终结技时，全体队友速度提高12%，持续1回合
bonus4pcEn: When the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate on an ally, increases all allies' SPD by 12% for 1 turn.

name: 野穗伴行的快枪手
bonus4pc: 装备者的速度提高6%，普攻伤害提高10%
bonus4pcEn: The wearer's SPD increases by 6% and Basic ATK DMG increases by 10%.

name: 过客的游迹
bonus4pc: 在战斗开始时，恢复1个战技点
bonus4pcEn: At the start of the battle, regenerates 1 Skill Point.

name: 废土客的荒漠
bonus4pc: 对陷入禁锢状态的敌方目标施放攻击时，暴击伤害提高10%，暴击率提高10%
bonus4pcEn: When attacking enemies with Imprisonment, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

name: 深囚的幽锁
bonus4pc: 目标每承受1个持续伤害效果，装备者对其暴击率提高5%，最多叠加3层
bonus4pcEn: For every DoT on the target, increases CRIT Rate by 5%, up to 3 stacks.

name: 死水深潜的先驱
bonus2pc: 对拥有3个及以上负面效果的敌方目标造成的伤害提高12%
bonus2pcEn: Increases DMG dealt to enemies with 3 or more debuffs by 12%.
bonus4pc: 敌方目标每承受1个负面效果，装备者暴击率提高4%，最多3层。对拥有3个及以上负面效果的目标，每个负面效果额外提高暴击伤害8%
bonus4pcEn: Increases CRIT Rate by 4% per debuff on the enemy (max 3 stacks). Against enemies with 3 or more debuffs, increases CRIT DMG by 8% per debuff.

name: 黄昏飞驰的猎鹰
bonus4pc: 当装备者施放终结技后，行动提前25%
bonus4pcEn: After the wearer uses Ultimate, advances action by 25%.

name: 戍关的雪原
bonus4pc: 回合开始时，恢复等同于装备者生命值上限8%的生命值
bonus4pcEn: At the start of the turn, restores HP equal to 8% of the wearer's Max HP.

name: 钟表匠的默想
bonus4pc: 当装备者施放终结技时，全体队友的击破特攻提高30%，持续2回合
bonus4pcEn: When the wearer uses Ultimate, increases all allies' Break Effect by 30% for 2 turns.

name: 铁骑的锋镝
bonus4pc: 当装备者的击破特攻大于等于150%时，击破伤害无视10%防御力。当击破特攻大于等于250%时，额外无视15%防御力
bonus4pcEn: When Break Effect is 150% or higher, Break DMG ignores 10% DEF. When Break Effect is 250% or higher, additionally ignores 15% DEF.

name: 烬烬之炎大公
bonus2pc: 追加攻击造成的伤害提高20%
bonus4pc: 追加攻击命中后，攻击力提高6%，最多叠加8层，持续3回合。追加攻击再次命中时刷新层数
bonus4pcEn: When follow-up attack hits, ATK increases by 6%, stacking up to 8 times for 3 turns. Stacks are refreshed when follow-up attack hits again.

name: 寂灭之诗
bonus4pc: 装备者速度降低8%。战斗中，速度每低于110的10%，暴击率提高8%，最多提高32%
bonus4pcEn: Decreases SPD by 8%. In battle, CRIT Rate increases by 8% for every 10% SPD below 110 (max 32%).

name: 太空封印站
bonus2pc: 攻击力提高12%。当装备者速度大于等于120时，攻击力额外提高12%
bonus2pcEn: ATK +12%. When SPD is 120 or higher, ATK increases by an additional 12%.

name: 不老者的仙舟
bonus2pc: 最大生命值提高12%。当装备者速度大于等于120时，全体队友攻击力提高8%
bonus2pcEn: Max HP +12%. When SPD is 120 or higher, increases all allies' ATK by 8%.

name: 泛银河商业公司
bonus2pc: 效果命中提高10%。攻击力提高等同于当前效果命中的25%
bonus2pcEn: Effect Hit Rate +10%. Increases ATK by an amount equal to 25% of the current Effect Hit Rate.

name: 档案馆的贝洛伯格
bonus2pc: 防御力提高15%。当防御力大于等于1200时，攻击力提高12%
bonus2pcEn: DEF +15%. When DEF is 1200 or higher, ATK increases by 12%.

name: 停转的萨尔索图
bonus2pc: 暴击伤害提高16%。当暴击伤害大于等于120%时，终结技和追加攻击暴击率提高15%
bonus2pcEn: CRIT DMG +16%. When CRIT DMG is 120% or higher, increases Ultimate and Follow-up ATK CRIT Rate by 15%.

name: 繁星竞技场
bonus2pc: 暴击率提高8%。当暴击率大于等于70%时，战技和普攻造成的伤害提高20%
bonus2pcEn: CRIT Rate +8%. When CRIT Rate is 70% or higher, increases Skill and Basic ATK DMG by 20%.

name: 折断的龙骨
bonus2pc: 效果抵抗提高10%。当效果抵抗大于等于30%时，全体队友暴击伤害提高10%
bonus2pcEn: Effect RES +10%. When Effect RES is 30% or higher, increases all allies' CRIT DMG by 10%.

name: 苍穹战线格拉默
bonus2pc: 攻击力提高12%。当速度大于等于135时，伤害提高12%；当速度大于等于160时，伤害提高18%
bonus2pcEn: ATK +12%. When SPD is 135 or higher, increases DMG by 12%. When SPD is 160 or higher, increases DMG by 18%.

name: 无主荒星
bonus2pc: 暴击率提高4%。当敌方目标被击败时，暴击伤害提高4%，最多叠加10层
bonus2pcEn: CRIT Rate +4%. When enemies are defeated, increases CRIT DMG by 4%, stacking up to 10 times.

name: 出云神世与高天神国
nameEn: Izumo Gensei and Takama Divine Realm
bonus2pc: 攻击力提高12%。当队伍中至少2名角色命途相同，暴击率提高12%
bonus2pcEn: ATK +12%. When at least 2 allies follow the same Path, increases CRIT Rate by 12%.

name: 奔狼的都蓝王朝
bonus2pc: 当队友施放追加攻击时，追加攻击伤害提高5%，最多叠加5层
bonus2pcEn: When allies use follow-up attacks, increases follow-up ATK DMG by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

name: 劫火莲灯的铸造
bonus2pc: 速度提高6%。当装备者攻击拥有火属性弱点的敌方目标时，击破特攻提高40%
bonus2pcEn: SPD +6%. When the wearer hits an enemy with Fire Weakness, increases Break Effect by 40%.
